content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0, R00.2). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate these symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities. Because the required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered, this appeal requests that the denial under Reason Code CO-197 be reversed, as the service was medically necessary to evaluate the patient's palpitations and irregular heartbeat."}
